_doc: DRAFT settings for the routing arms of the local-only test (route_run.py). Not frozen: the owner picks the models, budget and targets in the routing pre-registration, then this file is frozen (frozen: true) and only changed through DEVIATIONS.md. Tasks, memory (L1 notes), agent, budget and grading are experiment.json's, unchanged.

models._doc: model_key (as the routing model knows it) -> how to call it. Prices in USD per million tokens, used for the reported cost; the planner uses its own card prices.

check._doc: What the agent could know before delivering, computed from the same test run as the grade: 'regression' = the patch applies and every PASS_TO_PASS test passes (the repo's existing tests); 'partial' = regression and at least one FAIL_TO_PASS test passes (a reproduction test); 'oracle' = resolved (a perfect check, upper bound only).

primary_metric: mean delivered-task cost at a resolved rate not worse than STRONG by more than 3 points
